item.title: Cargo shipped through Port Milwaukee increased in 2025
item.description: A total of 2,322,072 metric tons of cargo were shipped through Port Milwaukee, an increase of 4% compared to shipping activity at the port in 2024, according to new figures released today by the city of Milwaukee. item.title: Metro Milwaukee home sales down in January, while prices rise
item.description: The number of homes sold in the four-county metro Milwaukee area was down 9.9% in January, year over year, while home sale prices rose 9.5%, according to the latest market report from the Greater Milwaukee Association of Realtors.
